newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo's key Nikkei index ends down nearly 2 pct.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo's key Nikkei index ends down nearly 2 pct.

text.p: The Tokyo stock market's key Nikkei average tumbled nearly two percent on Friday, extending its losses for a third straight day.
Wit few factors to buy on, brokers said the key index could slip below the 20,000 level in the near future.
The key 225-share Nikkei average tumbled 386.26 points or 1.88 percent to 20,166.90. Its September futures dropped 420 points to 20,170.
"The investment environment is bad both inside and outside," said Keiji Arai, a strategist at Sanyo Securities Co Ltd.
